total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of reported seed (~$6.5M, Apr 2024), Series A (~$21M, Nov 2024) and Series B ($40M, Jun 2025) per startups.in and getlatka.com aggregator profiles; the $40M Series B tranche itself is confirmed by Browserbase's own blog post.
total_funding_usd.quote: Browserbase (browserbase.com) has raised a total of about $67-68 million across three rounds, reaching a post-money valuation of roughly $300 million. Funding timeline: Seed round (~$6.5 M) in Apr 2024, Series A (~$21 M) in Sep 2024, and Series B ($40 M) on 22 Apr 2025 led by Notable Capital with participation from Kleiner Perkins and CRV.

last_round.quote: The product release coincides with a $40 million Series B financing round led by Notable Capital, with participation from existing investors CRV and Kleiner Perkins.

revenue.basis: Getlatka aggregator estimate of Browserbase's 2025/2026 ARR; no company-confirmed revenue figure found.
revenue.quote: Browserbase 2025 estimated revenue: $4.4M ARR. Total funding: $67.5M across 3 rounds. 40 employees. Founded 2024.

note: Founded by Paul Klein IV (solo founder); Series A (co-led by Kleiner Perkins, announced Nov 2024) followed a Kleiner Perkins-led seed earlier in 2024. Series B ($40M, led by Notable Capital, with CRV and Kleiner Perkins participating) closed around June 2025 at a roughly $300M valuation per third-party reporting (deepnewz.com, startups.in); the valuation figure itself is not confirmed by Browserbase directly.
